default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-748.title: Dollar-led index catch-up
E-748.hypothesis: WDO and WIN are inversely linked; when the dollar makes an unusual move and the index has not yet responded by half, slower index participants catch up in the opposite direction.

E-750.title: Volatility compression range break
E-750.hypothesis: When bar-to-bar volatility falls well below its recent norm, stops pile up around the small range; the first close beyond it releases the energy.

E-751.title: Shock-bar extreme follow-through
E-751.hypothesis: After a wide-range full-body bar, a next close beyond its extreme shows no one absorbed the move; late traders chase.

E-752.title: Late-session day-open cross
E-752.hypothesis: In the last hour, a close crossing the day's open decides the winners and losers of the day; position squaring pushes price the same way into the close.

E-753.title: VWAP sigma-band re-entry fade
E-753.hypothesis: A stretch beyond a deviation band around VWAP draws in value buyers; the first close back inside the band means the push is exhausted, so trade back toward VWAP.

E-754.title: Double marubozu follow
E-754.hypothesis: Two consecutive almost wickless bars the same way show an aggressor taking liquidity at every price; the move continues for a while.

E-755.title: Absorption at the range edge
E-755.hypothesis: Heavy volume with little range at the edge of the last half hour means passive orders absorbed the aggressors; fade back into the range.

E-756.title: Autocorrelation regime switch
E-756.hypothesis: When recent returns are negatively autocorrelated (noise from liquidity takers) a big bar is faded; when positively autocorrelated (herding) it is followed.

E-757.title: Weak-volume new extreme fade
E-757.hypothesis: A new session high or low made on below-average volume lacks participation; it is a probe that tends to retrace.
